en: Color postcard showing a modernist, socialist-era cultural building with a long portico and white columns, seen across a plaza with flowerbeds in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian postal printing (CARTE POSTALA, POSTA ROMANA), a pre-printed 40 bani stamp, a Bucharest postmark, a handwritten Romanian message and an address in Bucharest. Printed caption at lower left identifies the place as the Casa de cultură a sindicatelor in the city of Roman.
